targetText: Sismondi took over his theory of national revenue and of its division into two parts (the workers’ and the capitalists’) bodily from Adam Smith. Far from adding anything to Adam Smith’s theses, he even took a step backward and omitted Adam Smith’s attempt (albeit unsuccessful) to substantiate this proposition theoretically.
summary: Lenin points out the theoretical flaw underlying Sismondi's economics: blindly adopting Adam Smith's mistaken dogma that commodity values reduce entirely to wages and profits, completely ignoring constant capital replacement.
